title: The Silicon Society Cookbook: Design Space of LLM-based Social Simulations
comments: 20 pages, 12 tables, under review at COLM 2026
key_findings: Base LLM is the single most influential factor reported, with η²=0.266 on BERT AI-detectability and η²=0.090 on net consensus change.
BluePrint social media LoRA fine-tuning reduces BERT AI-detectability for Qwen and intensifies opinion dynamics relative to non-finetuned Qwen.

The design space is hybrid: some effects are additive, while survey context interactions are model-dependent and population-scale-dependent; a single biased news agent has no measurable effect in this setup.
evidence_note: Report based on arXiv abstract page, experimental HTML, downloaded PDF, and extracted PDF text. Claims are restricted to visible paper content.
